title: Payroll closes in 20 minutes
scenario: An employee emails HR saying they changed banks and need their salary redirected before payroll closes. The message has the employee’s normal signature and mentions their upcoming vacation.

answers.A: Hold the payroll change and ask the employee to update details through the HR system after identity verification.
answers.B: Change it now because delaying salary would harm the employee and the email context is convincing.
answers.C: Use the organization’s verified payroll-change process and confirm the employee through a known channel before changing bank details.

explanation: Attackers use urgency and personal context to redirect salary. Payroll destinations should change only through a controlled identity process.
proTip: Payday pressure should strengthen payroll controls, not bypass them.
